scope: Read-only acceptance build and in-container tool probe for the self-host server/Dockerfile

build.note: Dockerfile's tool-install and build-time FFmpeg/libopus probe layers were cached; the resulting image was independently run for the probe below.

runtime_tool_probe.command: docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint /bin/sh hichat-p10-selfhost-acceptance:origin-main-e3f915d4 -ec 'printf "yt-dlp="; yt-dlp --version; printf "deno="; deno --version | head -n 1; printf "ffmpeg="; ffmpeg -version | head -n 1; ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -f lavfi -i anullsrc=r=48000:cl=stereo -t 0.1 -c:a libopus -f ogg /tmp/hichat-p10-libopus-probe.ogg; test -s /tmp/hichat-p10-libopus-probe.ogg; printf "libopus_encode=PASS bytes="; wc -c < /tmp/hichat-p10-libopus-probe.ogg'
runtime_tool_probe.isolation: Ephemeral container used --rm and --network none, with no host volume or port; probe output was written only inside that container.

limits: This verifies only the self-host SQLite server image; the repository-root production/HF image was not built in this run.
No API service was started, and no YouTube extraction, LiveKit publication, real client playback, or two-client E2EE acceptance was tested.
This local image build does not prove deployment, production runtime readiness, or P10 release acceptance.
